name: yappp.
tagline: Random voice chat with strangers. No accounts, no waiting room.
description: Mobile app that pairs people into one-on-one voice conversations through a simple FIFO queue. Once matched, the server only does signaling; the audio itself is peer-to-peer WebRTC. You never get the same person twice.
highlights: Shared queue logic across React and React Native.

name: Beatam Noctem
tagline: Tickets, voting, and door check-in for one event. No accounts needed.
description: Built for Beatam Noctem 4.0. Attendees buy tickets without creating accounts. They receive QR-coded PDFs by email and SMS, then get scanned at the door. The same system handles award voting (one vote per email) and processes payments via Paystack. Processed 20,000+ cedis in ticket and vote sales.
highlights: Account-less flow from purchase to QR check-in.
Paystack webhooks + admin dashboard with audit logs.

name: ShuttleApp
tagline: Live shuttle map so KNUST students stop guessing at the stop.
description: Installable PWA that shows real-time positions of campus shuttles on a map. Students pick a stop or use their location, then see where the buses actually are. Built to feel native on iOS and can be added to the home screen. Roughly 500–1000 active student users.
highlights: Live shuttle tracking with map markers for stops.

name: Lucy's Perfumery
tagline: Storefront for original perfumes, diffusers, and body splashes.
description: Fast SPA where people browse by brand and category and check out. Over 1,000 active users. Deployed on a custom domain with shareable product pages.
highlights: Brand and category browsing with a lightweight React frontend.

name: Mula DataHub
tagline: Live GSE prices, company disclosures, and Ghana business news in one place.
description: Platform that brings live Ghana Stock Exchange prices together with annual/quarterly reports, public notices, and headlines from major local publishers. Over 500 active users. Currently expanding the backend and has launched a developer API.
highlights: Live GSE prices next to official filings and reports.
Developer API for real-time prices and structured data.
